Its own chapter because its scenes stand at 沉鼎观 (徐) and a chapter's scenes stand in its province (content.mjs lintScene); it sorts after 00-waimen and before 01-ji (chapters run in id order). `gate: 1` — the Foundation's breakthrough (09-cliff) is thrown here.
_map: The same small area around 沉鼎观 as 外门 (his, 2026-09-29: 地图分步打开): the year is spent on the mountain.

say.zh: 这几年，你在山上修行。没有差事，没筑基，不下山。
say.en: These years you cultivate on the mountain. No errand, and no going down before Foundation.

summary.zh: 头场雪夜，你对着那颗九转筑基丹算账，贴肉揣着；开春，残株分堆照方子喂，喂出了九转聚气丹。马小宝告你偷药园，周衡说「拿赃来」。一晃五年，一年一层；第五年腊八你赢了大比，观里那颗一转的官丹封好收进储物袋；入秋，九层大圆满。瞿老讲了他最后一个徒弟——九月初三，你在崖顶筑基。
summary.en: On the first snowy night you do your sums over the nine-turn Foundation pill and keep it against your skin; in spring you sort the culls by herb and feed them by recipe: nine-turn qi pills. Ma Xiaobao accuses you of robbing the herb garden; Zhou Heng says "bring the stolen goods". Five years go by, a layer a year; at Laba in the fifth year you win the contest, and the temple's one-turn pill, resealed, goes into the storage pouch; in autumn, layer nine, great perfection. Old Qu told of his last disciple — and on the third of the ninth month you lay your Foundation on the cliff.

intro.zh: 头场雪下了一夜。储物袋里，躺着一颗九道纹的。
intro.en: The first snow fell all night. In his storage pouch lies one pill with nine rings.

mystery.zh: 瞿老四十多年没收过徒弟——他上一个徒弟，后来怎样了？
mystery.en: Old Qu took no disciple for more than forty years — what became of the last one?

_close: The ending card (story.mjs closeOf): 古十 follows at once, so it stands on 01-arrive with 古九's 「完」 — what he did and the teaser, both to 你 (2026-10-01: a card says 你, the dialogue box plays the book in the third person; one card mixed 你 and 沈小满).

did.zh: 头场雪那一夜，你把一颗九转筑基丹贴肉揣了
did.en: On the first snowy night you put one nine-turn Foundation pill against your skin

did.zh: 五年后的腊八，赢下了观里那颗一转的官丹，粘好封条收进了储物袋
did.en: five years on, at Laba, won the temple's one-turn pill and glued its seal back and put it in the storage pouch

did.zh: 九月初三，你在崖顶筑了基——师父问几道纹，你说一道
did.en: and on the third of the ninth month you laid your Foundation on the cliff — your master asked how many rings, and you said one

teaser.zh: 却说北边漳水之滨，有一座邺城，城里年年要给河伯娶一回媳妇。今年巫祝挑中的新娘子，是城西卖豆腐的哑女——那时你还不知道，这门亲事，是要你去搅上一搅的。
teaser.en: Up north on the Zhang stands the city of Ye, which marries a bride to the River Lord every year. This year the shaman chose the mute girl who sells tofu on the west side — and you did not yet know that this wedding was yours to spoil.
